dogecoin.text: @TeslaDarth @elonmusk @dogecoin Each "Bitcoin" can be divided upto eight decimal places, it's ridiculous.

@TeslaDarth @elonmusk @dogecoin Also, since crypto can be divided into such small fractions, it's easily arguable that you can devalue the currency by "printing" your own money. You don't even have to front the cost of actually printing shit. You just divide the non-existent coin again.

1) Not backed by anything.

2) No privacy (easily traceable).

3) Not accepted everywhere.

4) No protection against theft.

5) Can be lost easily.

Literally every single one of those applies.

@TeslaDarth @elonmusk @dogecoin It's the same thing as the stock market crash before the great depression. They were selling "future" results, everyone was spending tons of money they thought their investments were paying for, then the shit tanked when the bubble of "infinite money" finally popped.

@TeslaDarth @elonmusk @dogecoin And not only inject money, but inject increasing amounts of money, so they can sell fractions of fractions of a non-existent "currency," to morons who become more and more invested in their scheme.

@TeslaDarth @elonmusk @dogecoin That's why people are creating new ways to *sell* it. People are making  blockchain "games," selling blockchain "properties," amongst other things. If it's valuable and the value grows with time, why don't they simply want to keep it? Because they need fools to inject money.

@TeslaDarth @elonmusk @dogecoin You're paying money for something that's worth nothing, and trying to get other people to pay more than you did, forever, to generate "passive" income.
